Requirement: Active account, valid password, forced password change; replace legacy hash with versioned modern password hashing.
Verification: Reject invalid/inactive account; forced-change path; logout clears session.

Requirement: Enforce action permissions in service layer, not just UI; deny missing grants.
Verification: Deny direct unauthorized calls; verify each role and document scope; test firm isolation.

Requirement: Client/contact management, primary contacts and compact search, with configurable numbering.
Verification: Search zero/one/many results; preserve client/contact links; validate create/edit permissions.

Requirement: Combined proposal/agreement document; controlled send, acceptance/rejection, linked engagement/project creation.
Verification: Repeated acceptance cannot duplicate project/engagement; invalid status change denied; document snapshot retained.

Requirement: Verify signed document and execution state before explicit authorization; no automatic start merely on acceptance.
Verification: Missing/changed signed file denies handoff; no authorization keeps Pending; approved handoff transitions correctly.

Requirement: Project status and setup checklist, parties, staffing, phase planning and task context.
Verification: Setup row existence not equivalent to completion; selected project remains consistent; unauthorized action denied.

Requirement: Production and restricted storage, folder registry, audit, generated-document registration.
Verification: Restricted list/download blocked; path traversal denied; failed registration consistent with file state.

Requirement: Task-oriented work center, clock in/out, time, expenses and attendance.
Verification: No duplicate open attendance session; employee scope; employee cannot self-approve restricted actions.

Requirement: Approval history and separation of time/expense facts from billing decisions.
Verification: Approval gates; rejected time excluded; unreviewed expense remains in queue.

Requirement: Review items/history and authorization of additional services; preserve linked work history.
Verification: Closed history read-only; unauthorized additional service cannot start work; review changes audited.

Requirement: Staff classification, approved time/expense review, and project-context workflow.
Verification: Classification and audit commit atomically; missing classification treated as unclassified.

Requirement: Create/edit/void with controlled numbering, history and consistent balance.
Verification: Concurrent numbering unique; void excluded per policy; failed write rolls back.

Requirement: Positive amount, method and balance checks; atomic payment posting.
Verification: Reject zero/negative normal payment and overpayment; concurrent payments cannot over-collect.

Requirement: Deposits, application, refund, adjustment and reversal with audit and atomic ledger effects.
Verification: Reject overapplication/refund; repeated reversal denied; rollback leaves both ledgers consistent.

Requirement: A/R, overdue reminders, profitability, financial/time reports; one authoritative calculation service.
Verification: Reconcile dashboard and reports; void and reversal fixtures; financial metrics never leak to unauthorized users.

Requirement: Context-aware engagement/project/billing workspaces, My Work, compact search, empty state.
Verification: No silent wrong-record selection; no hidden UI as security boundary; back/return retains context.

Requirement: Configurable branding, templates, numbering, firm scope, activation, backups and upgrades. New requirements, not verified existing functions.
Verification: Fresh install without Access; backup/restore and migration; offline licensing policy; isolated company data.

Requirement: Preserve phase planning, staff workload and schedule filters
Verification: Overlapping assignments, date boundaries, inactive staff, project context

Requirement: Preserve employee records and license expiry alerts; restrict compensation and rates
Verification: Role-restricted fields, expired and upcoming licenses

Requirement: Recreate eight exported report capabilities, not necessarily identical layout
Verification: Compare report totals and date filters on approved fixtures

Requirement: Staged import; preserve source IDs/history, reject orphan records, reset credentials, reconcile balances
Verification: Dry run, transactional publish, reject discrepancies

Requirement: Signed Windows installer, offline entitlement, safe upgrades and backups
Verification: Clean Windows install without Access; restore, upgrade and interrupted update

Requirement: Server API enforces firm and record access; no direct database credentials in desktop client
Verification: Cross-firm negative tests; race tests; API TLS and recovery
